correctness.rationale: Independent replay passes: python3 output/artifacts/verify.py -> n0=915 n1=6948 n2=15440 n3=13632 r0=914 r1=6031 r2=9408 H=(1,3,1), all 9 AW cups are coboundaries, H2 generator certified nonzero (VERIFY_OK). Auditor independently re-enumerated the Abrams model from G' (branch lengths 3,3,4; V=9,E=10): unordered disjoint-closure 4-tuples give cells [126,350,320,108,11], exactly matching cubes.pkl/model.json. Auditor fully validated the face lattice for all 915 barycentric vertices: proper[x] equals the transitive closure of the cubical face relation (replace an edge factor by either endpoint) with 0 mismatches; chain-count DP gives 6948/15440/13632/4224 simplices, matching the verifier. Auditor recomputed B1 rank 914 and rank(B1+H1 reps)=917=dim Z1, closing the verifier's gap (it checks cocycle-ness but not H1-independence): the 3 masks (weights 438/387/539) are cocycles spanning H1=F2^3. All 9 recorded cups equal the recomputed AW front/back-face products and satisfy d(w_ij)=cup_ij; bilinearity then kills every H1xH1 cup. H2 25-triangle generator is a cocycle and reduces nonzero mod im(d1). Abrams (k=2,n=4)-subdivision holds: A-B paths have 4,4,5 vertices (>=4=n-k+2) and every essential cycle has >=6 vertices (>=5=n-k+3), so D_4(G')~=Conf_4(G'); AW on Sd(D_4) induces the topological cup over F2 with no signs. Result is machine proof (finite F2 linear algebra), not experiment.

residual_risks: Homotopy equivalence D_4(G')~=Conf_4(G') rests on the standard Abrams theorem plus the verified subdivision counts, not on a re-proof inside the artifacts.
Cohomology-ring correctness rests on the standard fact that simplicial AW induces the topological cup (diagonal-independent); the artifacts verify one AW representative.
verify.py itself does not assert H1-independence mod coboundaries; the auditor filled this with an independent rank(B1+H1)=917 check.
OpenAlex returned HTTP 400 for one query index (partial coverage); SerpBase+Crossref+direct arXiv fetches cover the gap, but an unindexed thesis/table entry cannot be logically excluded.
No claim beyond F2, n=4, Theta_(2,3,4), H^1xH^1->H^2; Massey products and other coefficients/graphs remain open.
